overlay.reason: Seven of the 10 revisions have a pull request template with no evidence sections, and the /git skill changed after each revision. Each episode writes both files from the base revision into the worktree and marks them skip-worktree, so every episode measures the current conventions and the overlay cannot enter a commit.

episode_prompt: /git The working tree holds the complete change for issue #<N> ("<issue title>"). Create the task branch, commit the change, and write the pull request title on the first line of work/pr.md and the pull request body after it. Do not push and do not call GitHub.

amendments.change: Advisor rulings before the leak-free rerun: c6 leaves out each path that the patch adds and that the .gitignore files of the revision ignore; c5 accepts entries under the ## [<version>] section when the patch changes the version of package.json. The leaky run moved to runs/screen-leaky/ and was rescored with summarize.sh --rescore.

Leak fix before the rerun: episodes run in an isolated repository (make-episode-repo.sh) instead of a worktree of this repository; no-egress.sh also rewrites GitHub fetch URLs; claude_args disallow WebFetch and WebSearch. The prompt is unchanged.

episode_isolation: Each episode runs in a new repository under the XDG state directory that make-episode-repo.sh builds: a depth-1 fetch of the pinned revision, no remote, no ref. no-egress.sh blocks git push, git fetch from GitHub, and gh. claude runs with WebFetch and WebSearch disallowed.
